'''ZeHeth''' was an [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TFABG" /> [[Planet|world]]<ref name="SkeletonCrew">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}}</ref> located in the [[ZeHeth system]] of the [[Dustig sector]]<ref name="Appendix" /> in grid square N-16 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="TFABG" /> The [[super-hyperroute]]<ref name="BMF 48">{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> known as the [[Hydian Way]] connected it to the [[Malastare system]] as well as the [[Expansion Region]]'s [[Pax system]].<ref name="TFABG" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> while the [[astronomer]]<ref name="DB Khymm">{{Databank|khymm|Kh'ymm}}</ref> [[Kh'ymm]] was searching her archive of worlds on the [[Observatory Moon]] in order to determine the potential location of the lost planet [[At Attin]], ZeHeth's name was listed on her [[computer]] screen among other worlds.<ref name="SkeletonCrew" />

==Behind the scenes==
ZeHeth's name was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] on a [[The galaxy|galactic]] map in [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]], a [[2016]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' boxed set.<ref name="TFABG" /> It was subsequently first described as a distinct world in "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]],"<ref name="SkeletonCrew" /> the [[December 10]], [[2024]]<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}}</ref> third episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]''.<ref name="InterestingEpGuide">{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-3-episode-guide|text="Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}}</ref> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[ZeHeth/Legends|ZeHeth]]<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> was originally introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first mentioned in the [[1994]] ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Eric S. Trautmann|Eric Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>
